messages:
maria (release-eng): heads-up: planning a shadow swap of router v3.8 -> v4.0 in the midnight window (00:30-01:30 UTC). goal: validate new routing rules + weighted drain behavior without impacting live traffic.

devon (platform): +1. what’s the plan for traffic shaping? will we do 0% -> 5% shadow then promote to green?

maria (release-eng): correct. sequence: 1) shadow deploy to green cluster, 2) route 5% via mirror (no responses), 3) run e2e smoke + perf probes, 4) route 10% production if probes pass, 5) staged ramp. rollback if error rate or latency delta > 15% for 3 consecutive minutes.

deploy-bot: STARTING_ROLLOUT: router-v4.0 -> green=[router-green-4], shadow_mode=mirror, initiated_by=@maria, run_id=rl-31011122.

ashley (oncall): I’ll be on pager for the window. if app-500s spike, we should immediately cut mirror and pause ramp. I need the quick kill command.

tom (infra): quick kill is: `routectl set-weight router-prod router-green 0` then `routectl revert-to router-prod stable` — I’ll post a one-liner in #oncall.

li (eng-release): adding probe checklist: `curl -sS -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"` to /health and /generate on both clusters, and a lightweight embedding job to validate tokenization differences. Also run the KV cache warmup script.

maria (release-eng): logging the decision to pin model version at the router-level: `pin=redwood/llama2-13b@v2026-03-01` for green. We will only swap model pin if smoke matches.

ci-bot: CI_CHECKS: smoke-tests=passed, perf-baseline=ok, linters=ok (run_id=rl-31011122).

deploy-bot: TRAFFIC_CHANGE: mirror=5%, green_http_probe=enabled, time_window=00:30-01:30 UTC.

devon (platform): note: autoscale policies for green are capped at 2x to avoid runaway cost during tests. retry/backoff configured.

ashley (oncall): got it. alert thresholds set: p95 latency +20% (15m), 5xx rate >0.5% (1m). If either trigger, I’ll execute the kill and notify infra.

maria (release-eng): small change: we’ll also enable lightweight sampling for token-cost breakdown to catch regressions in generation length.

tom (infra): preflight checklist complete: certs on green confirmed, canary routing rules deployed to lb, circuit-breaker threshold set to 120s.

maria (release-eng): deploy-bot says mirror is live. please monitor logs for `route:mirror` tag. If green starts returning >2% mismatch on structured outputs, we will pin back.

deploy-bot: MIRROR_ACTIVE: mirror=5% -> started (timestamp=3101112250).

li (eng-release): running the embedding spot-check now. results: cosine diffs within tolerance, minor token-length +2% on average. logging to the release board.

maria (release-eng): thumbs — good. plan to ramp to 10% production (not mirror) at 00:50 if no alerts. confirm you’re ready to promote.

devon (platform): ready. I’ll watch LB metrics and BGP flaps.

ashley (oncall): ready from oncall side.

deploy-bot: PROMOTION_SCHEDULED: 00:50 UTC -> set-weight router-green=10% (gradual).

maria (release-eng): reminder: if any of these happens, rollback immediate: increased 5xx by 0.5pt, p95 latency +25% sustained, or structured-output mismatch >5%.

tom (infra): applying promotion now: `routectl set-weight router-prod router-green 10 --gradual 30s`

deploy-bot: TRAFFIC_UPDATE: router-green=10% (timestamp=3101112340).

li (eng-release): running post-promote probes. initial results: p95 +3%, 5xx flat, structured outputs stable. continuing watch for 10m.

maria (release-eng): excellent. after 30m of stable signals we’ll schedule the full cutover to v4.0 during the next window (or earlier if smoke is clean). final note: add release notes entry about routing changes and pin behavior. I’ll draft it after the window.

ashley (oncall): all quiet so far. will escalate if anything noisy. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: ROLL_CALL: participants acknowledged: maria, devon, ashley, tom, li.

maria (release-eng): thanks team — logging as successful shadow-swap start. follow-ups: release note draft, perf run next week, and a postmortem template in case we see regressions.

ci-bot: POST_ACTION: create ticket #RL-31011 for release notes + perf jobs.

tom (infra): leaving a small note: for future runs we should try `mirror-sampling=10%` earlier to catch token-length regressions sooner.

maria (release-eng): noted. closing thread for now — I’ll reopen if anything changes.
